items.title: Shameless: Very Important Punk
items.description: An archive of the French dub of the British television series, Shameless (2004-2013). Not to be confused with the American reincarnation, Shameless (2011-2021). Not available on streaming sites and save for the first two seasons, was not made available on DVD. Only the first six seasons were dubbed.
